title: Harbor LoopZero wrapper values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on Harbor mandates per MEET-2026-04-11-048. Critical decisions: trivy/notary/chartmuseum DISABLED, external PG (separate harbor_db), S3 storage (DO Spaces), ClusterIP-only (Traefik handles TLS), HA 2 replicas (ADR-0010 #4).

type.description: MUST be clusterIP — Traefik IngressRoute handles TLS externally per MEET-2026-04-11-048. Other types bypass Traefik = no TLS = data leak.

enabled.description: MUST be false — Traefik terminates TLS. Setting true would double-encrypt = silent failure or perf hit.

externalURL.description: Public URL (HTTPS only). Used by Harbor for callback URLs + image refs. HTTP would cause cosign sign + ArgoCD pull failures.

replicas.description: MUST be 0 — internal nginx disabled, Traefik is the ingress controller. Setting >0 creates dead pods.
Harbor core HA replicas. Default 2 (ADR-0010 #4 with anti-affinity). >5 = diminishing returns + PG connection budget burn.

type.description: MUST be external per MEET-2026-04-11-048. LoopZero uses managed PG with separate harbor_db. Internal embedded PG would violate state-isolation invariant.

port.description: PG port. Harbor upstream convention: STRING numeric (not integer). Pattern enforces digits only — '5432' OK, '5432;DROP TABLE' REJECTED, '' REJECTED, integer 5432 REJECTED (schema mismatch with upstream).

maxOpenConns.description: MEET-2026-04-11-048 CRITICAL mandate: maxOpenConns=10 (prevents pool exhaustion). >50 = burns shared managed PG pool budget.

enabled.description: MUST be false per MEET-2026-04-11-048. Trivy scanning happens in build pipeline via syft+grype, not Harbor-side. Enabling would duplicate scans + burn resources.
MUST be false — LoopZero uses cosign (sigstore) for signing, not Notary v1. Enabling = unused legacy DCT pods.
MUST be false — Harbor 2.10+ deprecated ChartMuseum, use OCI registry for charts.

resourcePolicy.description: PV reclaim policy. 'keep' default = retain PVC on uninstall (prevents data loss). 'delete' = uninstall wipes images.
